lines.text: Lena planned a winter trip to Yosemite from the east.
On the way up to Tioga Pass, she hit a locked gate.
That high road closes for winter, usually from November until late spring.
In winter, drive in from the west, carry tire chains, and check road status on nps.gov the morning you go.
Yosemite Valley stays open all year.
Next day, Lena walked to Lower Yosemite Fall in fresh snow.
Save this before your Yosemite trip.
